body.name: Finite rational normalized-quadratic encoding
body.construction: An encoding \(Q\) begins with self-delimiting binary encodings of \(m\), the number of constraints, and \(s_Q\); each constraint has an operation tag, binary coordinate indices in \(\{1,\ldots,m\}\), and, only for \(x_i=c\), a signed binary numerator and positive binary denominator in lowest terms; the final block lists the \(m\) reduced rational coordinates of \(z_Q\). The decoded set \(\operatorname{Sol}(Q)\subseteq\mathbb R^m\) consists exactly of vectors satisfying every listed equality.
